name: Linux Disk Write Bytes
programText:
raw = data('kafka_server_kafkaserver_value', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('name', 'linux-disk-write-bytes')).sum(by=['service.instance.id'])
((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Disk Write Bytes/sec')
